framing: matched initialization controls of the unchanged refresh-replay circuit (ideal drivers); the physical regime is a zero-hold preparation control, not a retention/hold study (#94)
scope: 27 C and 125 C, tt/ss/ff/sf/fs global corners, VDD 1.8 V, no mismatch (PROPOSED range, not ratified)

rtl_trace_pins.time_base: 1 cycle = 1 ns (study assumption, not a silicon frequency claim)
rtl_trace_pins.sampling: strobes sampled 0.1 ns after each rising clock edge; zero-width delta glitches not exported

regimes.legacy: unchanged #131 control instances: SN = label (.ic), no RWL pin IC, tran uic
regimes.pin_ic: legacy + explicit idle-high RWL pin IC (the #134 ic_artifact_check change); nothing else
regimes.physical: zero-hold physical write/settle: row-0 SN starts at the opposite data level {'op1': 0.0, 'op0': 1.2}, RWL pin IC idle-high, ideal prep driver writes the label onto WBL (100 ohm switch) with a WWL pulse 1-21 ns, WBL returned to 0 V at 22 ns, switch open 23 ns, op shifted +24 ns
regimes.init_negative: pwnw_rwl_late_hold: physical regime with the preparation WWL pulse deleted (SN stays at the opposite level)

preparation_assumptions.prep_driver: ideal PWL source at the label voltage through the existing 100 ohm swwbl switch model
preparation_assumptions.unavoidable_changes: all op edges/probes +T_PREP; latch/bitline nodes float for T_PREP before the op precharge
preparation_assumptions.note: ASSUMPTIONS; the label voltage is driven, not tuned: the achieved post-write level is measured and reported

probe_definitions.snpre: PRE-READ level: SN of row 0 at (read-select assert edge start - 0.1 ns); the nominal label never stands in for it
probe_definitions.snini: IC regimes: SN at 0.5 ns (after the t = 0 start-up steps). physical: ACHIEVED POST-WRITE level, SN at 21.9 ns (after the prep WWL fall ramp)
probe_definitions.snos: physical only: SN at op start - 0.1 ns (after the WBL return and switch open)
probe_definitions.dec: signed latch decision d = V(rbl) - V(ref) just before the op WWL rise (stored '1' -> d <= -0.9 V, '0' -> d >= +0.9 V)
probe_definitions.snend: SN at the gating restore probe (#131 control value, +T_PREP in the physical regime)

startup_uplift.note: sign reproduced = every legacy RTL-timing pre-read lies ABOVE its label; the documented range was 'about'

sense_vs_pre_read.note: all regimes share the circuit and the sense waveform of their family; the label is not used here, only the measured pre-read
